title: BTS airline outcome definitions and comparison scope
on_time_definition: A flight is on time if it arrives less than 15 minutes after its scheduled arrival time. This is an arrival measure, not an on-time departure measure.

count_columns.scheduled_flights: Total reported flights in the carrier row.

partition: The four outcome counts in each supplied row sum to the scheduled flight count. For a completed, nondiverted comparison, include the on-time and delayed categories, excluding both canceled and diverted categories.
limits: These are flight counts, not passenger counts. A single month's aggregate outcomes do not adjust for routes, airports, weather exposure, flight distance, or passenger volumes and do not establish causal or year-round superiority.
preparation_note: Definitions and scope are summarized from the report, with the comparison denominator stated explicitly for this exercise. This file does not represent an independent measurement source.
